Does not follow links from an X-Robots-Tag nofollow page when robots directives are respected

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
use Crawlberg\CrawlConfig;
$engine_config = CrawlConfig::from_json(json_encode(["maxDepth" => 1, "respectRobotsTxt" => true]));
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine($engine_config);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::crawl($engine, $url);
var_dump(count($result->getPages()));
var_dump($result->getPages()[0]->nofollowDetected);
var_dump($result->getPages()[0]->noindexDetected);
```
